text:
jen: Postmortem follow-up from the KV eviction incident. Captured the remediation owners and proposed eval/test additions so we don't regress. Short plan below.
omar: thanks jen. can you map owners + deliverables?
jen: yes. owners: regression suite + prompt bank -> @kevin; nightly smoke + load replay -> @priya; chaos drill orchestration + rollback dry-run -> @omar. timelines: prompt bank 7bd, load job 4bd, chaos drill 12bd.
kevin: taking regression suite. will curate ~30 failing/edge prompts and add unit checks. Need the raw traces and sample API logs.
jen: raw traces at s3://ops-postmortem/kv-evict/2026-03-22/telemetry.tar.gz. quick extract: 
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://ops-postmortem/kv-evict/2026-03-22/telemetry.tar.gz - | tar xz -C /tmp/kv-evict
python tools/parse_api_logs.py /tmp/kv-evict --out tests/promptbanks/kv-evict-raw.jsonl
```
priya: on the nightly replay: planning a helm release with a k8s cronjob hitting staging router 03:30 UTC daily, replaying sampled timelines at original QPS (capped). suggest --concurrency 40 and --max-tokens 220 to mirror incident.
jen: sounds good. sample cron: 
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: kv-replay-nightly
spec:
  schedule: "30 3 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: replay
            image: ghcr.io/redwood/replayer:stable
            args: ["--source", "s3://ops-postmortem/kv-evict/2026-03-22/sample.jsonl", "--target", "staging", "--concurrency", "40", "--max-tokens", "220"]
```
omar: chaos drill: scoped plan is to simulate gradual KV node loss in staging (20% -> 60% over 15m) while ramping traffic. validate graceful fallback to model-variant 'latency-safe-v2' and KV miss metrics. need a 2hr window and IR approval. ops-bot can you request window?
ops-bot: Request recorded. Proposed window 2026-04-09 09:00-11:00 UTC. IR approval required 48h ahead. React with :white_check_mark: to approve.
kevin: about integrating prompt bank into CI: I'll add evals/regressions/kv-evict/promptbank.jsonl and a Github Actions workflow that runs similarity checks and token-level regression metrics. Fail PRs if false-positive rate rises > 2.5% or median latency increases > 10%.
priya: will add a staging dashboard tile for these new metrics: kv_miss_rate, kv_retries, fallback_invocations, model_fallback_latency. can ops open a console ticket?
jen: filed ticket https://github.com/redwood/console/issues/3071 for dashboard metrics.
omar: rollback playbook update: ensure routing fallback TTL is 30s and add an automatic circuit-breaker if fallback_rate > 25% for 5m. example diff: 
```diff
 routing:
-  fallback: none
+  fallback:
+    variant: latency-safe-v2
+    ttl_seconds: 30
 circuit_breaker:
-  enabled: false
+  enabled: true
+  fallback_rate_threshold: 0.25
+  evaluation_window_seconds: 300
```
kevin: will include promptset unit tests and add a quick fuzz harness to catch tokenization edge cases. plan to open PR by 1768870000.
priya: ETA check: will have nightly helm chart + replay job in staging by 1768840000, will post deployment link.
jen: action recap:
- kevin: curate prompt bank + regression tests (7bd)
- priya: implement nightly replay + dashboard metrics (4bd)
- omar: chaos drill + rollback dry-run + IR window (12bd)
- jen: coordinate PRs, add CI gating, and kick-off quarterly recurrence review (created GH issue https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/1433)
jen: marking blockers if not started by EOD Monday. ping @here for visibility :eyes: 
kevin: sample promptbank uploaded: https://storage.redwood.ai/promptbanks/kv-evict-v1.jsonl
priya: replay job helm chart pushed: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/helm/charts/kv-replay/pulls/12
omar: approved the window :white_check_mark:. will start drafting the drill runbook.
jen: thanks team. we'll sync in 48h on progress and update the postmortem action tracker.
